blocks.text: Roxanne Barcelo and Faith Cuneta are among the artists who are set to reunite for “Stars Reignited: The Metropop Star Search Concert Reunion – The Repeat” on Nov. 28. The repeat concert follows the sold-out Sept. 5 performance at Teatrino in Greenhills, which brought together former contestants and winners of the Metropop Star Search competition. Organizers announced the encore following the strong public response to the reunion show. Joining Barcelo and Cuneta are Xaxa Manalo, Champagne Morales, Miles Poblete, Camille Velasco and Anna Katrina Lara. The reunion was conceptualized by Poblete, the competition’s 1999 grand champion.
